description: This file defines the 'Filter' controller class within the Opencart admin's catalog namespace. It handles CRUD operations, listing, sorting, filtering, and form submissions related to product filters for the admin interface of the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing filters in the catalog section of OpenCart's admin panel, including listing, form, save, and delete operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load and display the filter list page, with sorting and filtering options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response for listing filters, typically used via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filters based on current filter and sort parameters, returning a view rendering the filter list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save a filter, performs validation, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filters and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for filter names, returning a JSON list filtered by query.
